window.evaluation_start_rule: first exact normal KRX session on or after 2014-01-01
window.initial_ma60_unavailable_signal_months: reject only the affected candidate signal; do not shift P1 start

universe.authority: validated rolling merged PIT COMMON intervals, exact signal-date ticker + standard ISU_CD + market

strategies.candidate: same frozen V2; add signal-date prior-completed-month alignment and exact signal-date PIT KRX market-cap gate only

candidate_alignment.input_window: 20 and 60 prior completed monthly closes; signal month excluded

candidate_market_cap.source: immutable KRX raw daily market cap partition
candidate_market_cap.identity: exact signal-date PIT ticker + standard ISU_CD + market

portfolio.cash_shortage: skip entire entry as SKIPPED_CASH_UNAVAILABLE; no partial purchase
portfolio.sale_proceeds_available: next normal KRX session (T+1); not reused at same opening price
portfolio.replay_order: deterministic sequential chronological portfolio replay, exact fixed order for simultaneous entry events

valuation.daily_nav: available cash + pending sale proceeds + evidenced receivables + integer shares times exact evaluation-date adjusted close
valuation.unresolved_mark: whole portfolio NAV date UNRESOLVED; exclude whole date from observed MDD, never substitute or partially omit holdings
valuation.authorized_placeholder_carry: only source-confirmed non-trading placeholders and only for daily valuation/MDD; full identity/date/evidence audit required
valuation.cutoff_open_positions: mark at valid cutoff close only; no hypothetical exit, fee, tax, or liquidation

official_gates.B: all actual buy/sell fills include 0.015% commission and 0.1% adverse slippage per side; official tax 0
official_gates.C: total_return_pct > 0 and CAGR > 0 for each group

execution.signal_worker_execution: 10 forked processes inheriting immutable Repository V2/PIT/calendar context copy-on-write; no fallback; portfolio replay remains single-threaded
